title: Build queue activity log + session archive with per-prompt costs (Build manager Activity + Sessions tabs)
asked: Keep a detailed log of the build queue and changes to it with a very complete inclusive and powerful browser to browse activity in the queue like all moves and rearrangements, additions, removals like why and what prompt caused it || ALSO (bundled, Brett 14:33): equally powerful session archive log and viewer recording all sessions with system, user, app/browser/device, prompts, each prompt cost, input/output cost, changes and features touched, detailed cost record for the build manager; retroactively for every session in AmberX Framework and axHub projects

steps.text: queue-log@1: diff engine (adds, removals, moves, status/model/estimate/steps/notes) + daily log files on the hub
Record from every writer (CLI, console API, MCP, engine-rpc) with who, surface, why and the prompt
Catch queue changes made outside the tools (axHub direct writes, claude.ai, git sync)
session-archive@1: transcript parser, per-prompt tokens + cost, system/app/device, files and features touched
Session recorder hooks (Stop/SessionEnd) + claude.ai recording format
Cost record for the Build manager: sessions → changes → builds, actual vs estimated
Server API: queue log, sessions, cost record
Build manager Activity tab (timeline, filters, item history, moves, why/prompt)
Build manager Sessions tab (archive browser, prompt drill-down, costs, devices) + Costs view
Backfill: VPS host + container Claude Code transcripts (approval)
Backfill: claude.ai chats in AmberX Framework + prompt for the axHub project
steps.note: 35 AmberX Framework chats in the inbox (4 read in part: hourly read limit); axHub project chats need the prompt pasted in that project

steps.text: Backfill: change-log entries + session check-ins linked into the archive
steps.note: build-log entries counted in the cost record; no session check-in logs on the hub

result.summary: Queue activity log + session archive built (Build manager Activity, Sessions, Cost by build), recording hooks, inbox, backfill of VPS transcripts and AmberX Framework chats. Left: axHub project chats (prompt to paste there) and the unread parts of 4 long chats.
